rationale: Designed a monotonic Volt-Var curve with 9 voltage breakpoints from 0.92 to 1.08 pu. The curve provides full reactive power injection (+1.0) at low voltages, transitions through no reactive power at nominal voltage (1.0 pu), and provides full reactive power absorption (-1.0) at high voltages. This design addresses the low voltage condition at t_low (0.94 pu) and high voltage condition at t_high (1.07 pu) while respecting inverter reactive power capabilities and maintaining monotonicity constraints.
